label: UNIT3D
description: Standard UNIT3D private tracker. Provides /api/user stats and scrapes the /users/{username} profile page for extended stats.
notes: capabilities.api_stats is the STOCK UNIT3D /api/user response. Forks vary: one returning more should say so with api_stats_add in its own def (see zenith), one returning less with api_stats_omit. join_date is listed here because the forks that omit it already declare api.required_fields: ["join_date"], which is subtracted automatically. NEEDS CONFIRMATION against a live stock instance — assembled from the test fixture and field map rather than from UNIT3D's own documentation. Inactivity: stock UNIT3D disables an account after 90 days without a login and deletes it after 120, which is why so many tracker defs here carry rules.max_login_gap_days 90 (the first consequence — the last point a login still saves the account). It is recorded per TRACKER and deliberately NOT set here as a type default: operators change the numbers (several run 60) or switch the behaviour off, and an inherited 90 would turn "nobody has checked this install" into a confident claim on every UNIT3D tracker. Absent means unknown, and the countdown stays silent on unknown.
